sources.name: e-NAM commodity quality
sources.note: Commodity-specific assaying parameters; ordinary photos cannot certify these measurements.

cattle: Observe milking and check records if dairy
Age, pregnancy and weight need independent evidence
poultry: Confirm count and measured live weight
Check age, batch and movement records
Video activity alone cannot prove flock health
eggs: Check sample breakage, size and packing
aqua: Confirm species, size grade and count/kg
Disease, residues and freshness need suitable checks
dairy: Test fat, SNF and relevant milk quality
Measure volume and agree acceptance tests
Adulteration and pathogens cannot be checked from media

capture.crops: Show a spread-out sample, the full lot, bags and a scale; avoid filters.
capture.produce: Show close-ups, different sides, mixed crates and a short sorting video.
capture.cattle: Show both sides, identification and a clear walking clip; dairy listings can add an uncut milking record.
capture.smallstock: Show individual animals and the whole flock; include a scale and a short walking clip.
capture.poultry: Show the flock, batch identification, a sample scale reading and a short continuous clip.
capture.eggs: Show trays, a close-up, collection/batch label and packing; do not infer fertility from appearance.
capture.aqua: Show the lot, grading/count and a scale; record harvest/handling time separately.
capture.dairy: Show labelled containers and collection records; include measured test results separately.
